story.en: John and Emily are a couple, but recently they have been experiencing some friction. Little disagreements have escalated into full-blown arguments, making open communication a challenge. One sunny Saturday, they decide to visit the local street market, hoping a change of scenery might help. As they strolled past a flower stall, a kind-faced old woman noticed them. Sensing the tension, she gently suggested that they exchange a bouquet of flowers as a symbol of reconciliation and a fresh start. John glanced at Emily, a flicker of hope in his eyes, and gave a subtle nod. He carefully surveyed the various bouquets, his gaze lingering on each one before finally selecting a vibrant, blooming sunflower. The old woman smiled warmly as she handed him the sunflower. John, clutching the flower, turned back to present it to Emily, but at that moment, she was engrossed in browsing the colorful pottery at a nearby stall, seemingly oblivious to his gesture. With a sigh, John silently and discreetly placed the sunflower into her open shopping bag, hoping she would notice it later.
story.fa: امیر و سارا یک زوج هستند، اما اخیراً به‌خاطر برخی مسائل جزئی دچار سوتفاهم‌هایی شده‌اند و ارتباط بین آن‌ها سخت شده است. در یک روز، هر دو به بازار محلی دست‌فروشان می‌روند. پیرزنی امیر را می‌بیند و پیشنهاد می‌دهد که آن‌ها یک دسته گل را به‌عنوان نماد آشتی با هم تعویض کنند. امیر نگاهی به سارا می‌اندازد، پنهانی سرش را تکان می‌دهد و از بین دسته‌گل‌های مختلف، یک گل آفتابگردان شکوفا را انتخاب می‌کند. پیرزن گل آفتابگردان را به او می‌دهد، و او پس از گرفتن آن، دوباره به سارا نگاه می‌کند، اما در آن لحظه سارا مشغول نگاه کردن به سایر غرفه‌هاست. امیر بی‌صدا گل را در کیف خرید او می‌گذارد.

story.en: John, a sharply dressed businessman in a tailored suit, entered a quaint bakery. The aroma of freshly baked goods filled the air as he purchased a box of chocolate chip cookies. Stepping aside near a small, round table, his phone rang. After a brief conversation, he ended the call. Turning back, he noticed the box of cookies sitting on the table. Assuming they were his, he sat down and began to enjoy them. Just then, an elderly gentleman, dressed in worn and faded clothing, sat opposite him and also started eating the cookies from the same box. John, visibly annoyed and with a disdainful look, assumed the old man was stealing his cookies. He snapped, "If you can't afford them, don't eat them." He finished the remaining cookies and briskly walked out of the bakery. As he reached the door, he reached into his briefcase to retrieve some documents, and his hand bumped against a familiar cardboard box.
